core_categories: Food Packaging and Disposables; Cleaning and Hygiene Supplies; Safety and PPE; Retail and General Packaging; Healthcare Consumables
specialty_focus: Bunzl is a global specialist distribution and outsourcing group supplying businesses with non-core, day-to-day operational consumables (Goods Not For Resale). It operates through localized specialist businesses across the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the UK, serving sectors such as grocery, food service, cleaning, retail, and healthcare. Bunzl does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices; its healthcare segment provides general consumables.
